content: Fardghǝrǝt bi nǝ zaraabaha Yesu tǝ iin biya
Tǝhalakwaha kaa gwaivagwaig kǝ Yesu ma haaya Galili, naha bi kǝ damma haaya Yahud biya, aɗaba ar gata ɗuula tsǝgaan nǝ maalaha Yahudah vaakwaha.
Hǝrzǝt ba nǝ sarta haarakǝssa taha babramaha yaa Yahuda,
kaa tagartag kǝ zaraabahaan kǝ Yesu taakiya, “Marawuraana magha dagal damma Yahudiya, kiyava nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ mbǝrzahaghi vaakwah kǝ dǝgaha jappǝri agha ɓag nǝnga.
Abi lii naa sǝrvtǝr ar maay shǝɓa dǝgiti ar ɓag nǝ-iitǝr biya. Nalnǝg tsau taaki agha ɓagaan kǝ kwanahaan kǝ dǝgitaha, agha margaan kǝ ghǝragh kiyava sǝraksǝrg kǝ duniya.”
Aɗaba aanji zarha babbaan kǝ Yesu ndakwi fardghǝrit bi tǝ iin biya.
Am Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Ɓagaa bi sartar ndan biya, vakaruwa aanji kwar kǝ sarta, ba kalkala.
Da ɗuukurǝs bi nǝ duni kǝskuram biya, kai wa ɗuukus nǝ iina. Aɗaba ǝn tagar tlǝraha kǝladǝri ɓag nǝ iina.
Damdǝg nǝ uuram dagal da vaka haarakǝssiina, ǝn maay nai dagal biya, aɗaba ɓagaa bi nǝ sartar ndan biya.”
Tǝhalakwa tagatǝrda nǝ Yesu kwanǝn kǝ ǝlbǝga, kaa ndzǝgandzǝg kǝ iin ndan ma Galili.
Dal nǝ Yesu da vaka haarakǝssa
Daral ba nǝ zarha babba Yesu da vaka hwaɗaga haara kǝsna, kaa ba dagal kǝ Yesu tǝhalaatǝr kwal sǝrgasǝrgaatǝra, kwal nǝghǝga kǝ uudaha.
Kaa gatǝgaan kǝ maalaha Yahudah vaka haara kǝssǝna, ar ndava taaki, “Mǝr nǝ uuda nǝ iini?”
Kaa ba ɗung kǝ uudah mataatakaatǝr vaka dzahavǝn tǝghǝr kǝ Yesu. Kyalǝm ar taakiya, “Uuda jiijiir nǝ iina.” Kyalǝm dlaɓ ar taakiya, “Maaya, abi vala ba uudaha.”
Maay wa shughana gyi kǝ taaghai tǝghǝr kǝ Yesu tǝ ɓalaɓal biya, aɗaba ar gǝdza maalaha Yahudaha.
Yesu tsagtǝr dǝgit kǝ uudah vaka haara kǝssa
Davǝm ba damma ghadghada haara kǝsna, Kaa daas kǝ Yesu damma vǝgya Daadamazhigǝl kaa farzha kǝ tsagtǝr dǝgit kǝ uudaha.
Kaa ɓa jappǝr kǝ Yahudahi ndzar vaakwah ar ndava taakiya, “Tsaguu ndar nǝ uudanǝn kǝ dǝgit ǝndkwan bakwal dǝgal damma makaranti?”
Kaa ngwangug kǝ Yesu amaa, “Dǝginahaan ǝn tsag naina, dǝgar biya dǝga daddakwa ɓǝlakwaadi kaiya.
Baɗǝm daddakwa kǝsghaakakǝsǝg kǝ ɓa dǝgiti naag Daadamazhigǝla, da nǝghǝgaakanǝghǝg taakiya tsagaanara sǝghawi vak Daadamazhigǝla, vakar biya.
Daddakwa tsaga dǝga ghǝraana, tsag mbakyarvad faara kǝ ghǝraana. Daddakwa naa fǝgaara kǝ daddakwa ɓǝladi iina, taa ba jiira, maay nǝ fiid ma ghaiyan biya.
Abi Muus wa vǝlakur adzahadzah? Bakǝvakwaha maay ma kuram wa tsuufǝghant adzahadzahiin biya. Aujilbǝg ci kǝskuram am naa tsakayi?”
Kaa ngwangug kǝ uudah taakiya, “Mǝng nǝ shatanah ma vǝghagha. Yaar dlaɓ wanaa tsakǝghi?”
Kaa ngutǝrangug kǝ Yesu taakiya, “Ba dǝga jappǝr pal wa ɓagana nai davala ngiiga, baɗǝmmaru ɓagamaɓag kǝ ajappa.
Vǝlakurvǝlǝg nǝ Muus kǝ adzahadzaha ɓa guvaca, bakǝvakwaha iin bi wa fǝgharzhafǝg biya, fararzha daadijaha daadijaharuwa. Am ɓagaan kǝ aguvac aanji daghuvala ngiiga.
Akwama ɓagvaraɓag nǝ aguvac kǝ zǝr daghuvala faciya ngiigga kiyava tsuufa tsagaana Muusa, aujilbǝg ci kǝskuram am nguɗa ǝrivǝɗ dǝ kai mbakyarvad uudi mbanna nai daghuvala ngiigi?
Ɓagam bi kǝ shari nǝgha gyi biya, ɓagamɓag kǝ shariy tǝdvad jiirjiira.”
Yesu iin nǝ Kǝristi
Makwahiin kǝ sarta, kaa ndavǝg kǝ kyalǝma uudahi kwar ndzǝga ma Wurshalima taakiya, “Abi, kwan kǝ-uud war naa tsǝg nǝ-iitǝr?
Iin ɗang wan taaghai bat ɓalaɓalǝn? Tagarar bi aanji ndau biya. Nii mbatak hayaranthaig maalah taakiya iin Kǝristiyin hii?
Ghwalvǝn kiyam sǝrgasǝrǝg kǝ vakavaki sǝghsal dǝ iina, akwama da sǝghawisǝg nǝ Kǝristi jiirjiira, maay wada sǝrgasǝrg kǝ vakavaki sǝghal dǝ-iin biya.”

Ba ndzǝgaan ba tsagtǝr dǝgit nǝ Yesu kǝ uudah ma vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla, kaa dzǝgantdzǝg kǝ iin kǝ kunngy amaa, “Aana am sǝrkwasǝrga, am sǝrgasǝrǝg dlaɓ kǝ vakavaki sanal naiya. Sanhi dǝ ndzǝɗa ghǝrar biya, aɗaba Daadamazhigǝli ɓǝlakwadi kaiya dadda jiir nǝ iina, kuram am sǝrgabi nǝ uuram kǝ-iin biya.
Ən sǝrgasǝrǝg nai kǝ-iina aɗaba sanhi vakkaana, iin dlaɓa wa ɓǝlakwadiɓǝlǝga.”
Tagada ba nǝ Yesu kǝ kwanǝn kǝ ǝlbǝga, kaa gata viigaan kǝ uudaha. Maay wa fǝt dǝv tǝ vakai biya aɗaba ɓagaa bi sartaan biya.
Bakǝvakwaha uudah ba baɗyaka ma dlammakǝlaw fardghǝrǝtfǝg tǝ Yesu, ar taakiya, “Aitsaa, ma sartǝn da saay nǝ Kǝristiyin tsaa, da ɓagaan ni kǝ dǝga jappǝrah kwa juujig kwa ɓagaa nǝ ghwalvǝna?”
Cinngaraba nǝ Farisiyah kǝ uudah taa ghaiy tǝghǝr kǝ Yesu ma haay ma haaya, Kaa ɓǝlgantɓǝlǝg kǝ maalaha Zhilla kǝsuufah ard Farisiyah kǝ lii uufa vǝgya Daadamazhigǝl da viigaana.
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Tǝmma ba hǝɗiikǝn sarta ndzǝganar vakaru, tǝhala kwaha ǝn da gwiya daas da vak dadda kwa ɓǝlakwadiɓǝlga.
Am da gatkwagatǝgga am da tlǝkwi biya. Vakavaki dǝ kai am da sǝgǝv biya.”
Aiyam nǝ Yahudah ma taatakaatǝra, “Naa da dagal da vaakwar nǝ uudanǝn kwada tlǝvaraa bi ni? Mbatak da dagal da vak Yahudahǝn kwazaral ar ndzǝgan dǝ Helenahǝn kiyava tsagtǝr kǝ Helenah vaakwah hi?
Auwa tlatlǝg nǝ-iin dǝ taakiya, ‘Am da gatkwagatǝg, am da tlǝkwi bi ni’? Au dlaɓ wa tlatlǝg nǝ-iin taakiya, ‘Vakavaki dǝ kai am da sǝgǝv bi nii’?”
Taatǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ langyiya yu kwa vǝla shifǝga
Daghuvala ghyǝngnga haara kǝssa, iin faci kwa juujig baɗǝmma, kaa ghacigaghacig kǝ Yesu dzǝgant kǝ ghaiyaan amaa, “Baɗǝm daddakwa njikǝn nǝ andǝla aa sasǝg sa vakar da hǝɓuwa.
Baɗǝm daddakwa fadghǝr tǝ kaiya, bandkwa taga nǝ ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝl vinda-vinndana taakiya, njamara yuwa kwa vǝla shifǝga da kǝla sagal ma ǝrviɗyana.”
Tag tǝghǝr kǝ Shiɗǝkwa Daadamazhigǝl nǝ Yesu, kwada dlǝghǝg lii fadghǝr tǝ iina, aɗaba ma kwanǝn kǝ sarta vǝlavda bi nǝ Shiɗǝkw Daadamazhigǝl ndan biya, aɗaba favvaara bi nǝ Yesu ndan biya.
Cinngara ba nǝ kyalǝma uudah kǝ ǝlbǝgǝn tagaa nǝ Yesu na, kaa am nǝ-iitǝra, “Ba pakat kwanǝn kǝ uuda Tlayanga.”
Am nǝ kyalma, “Iin nǝ Kǝristi.” Gwastǝna kyalǝm ar ndava taakiya, “Ɓaga ndar nǝ Kǝristi sagal ma Galili?
Abi tagatag nǝ ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝl vindavindan taakiya Kǝristi da sagal ma kuɗiga Dauda? Dlaɓa ma Bitalahami kǝssǝn kwa ndzaa nǝ Daudǝn biya?”
Aɗabad kwaha, kaa tagwvǝmtagw nǝ araja uudah tǝghǝr kǝ Yesu.
Kyalǝm nahar viyarviiga, bakǝvakwaha, maay wa fǝt dǝv tǝ-iin biya.
Fardǝghǝrǝtbi nǝ maalaha yaa Yahuda tǝ Yesu biya
Gwiyara ba nǝ lii uufa vǝgya Daadamazhigǝlǝn daada vak maalaha zhiila kǝssauufah ard maalaha Farisiyaha, kaa ndavtǝruundavǝg nǝ maalahaan taakiya, “Aujilbǝg samdaabi?”
Am nǝ-lii uufǝgǝna, “Maay nǝ uudi tapghana taaghai ndǝ ghwalvǝn biya.”
Am nǝ Farisah taa kǝ-lii uufǝgǝna, “Caa, baz kuram ndakwani valakurda valǝga?
Nii mǝng ha nǝ uud maamal ma uudah bi ma Farisiyah kwa fadǝghǝrǝt tǝ-iin hii?
Maaya, bamma uudahaan kwar sǝrgai kǝ dǝgit tǝghǝr kǝ tsaga Muus biya. Tlafatǝratlafǝg nǝ Daadamazhigǝla.”
Nikodimus kwandza dal da vak Yesu wura, dlaɓa palma dakwalaatǝra, kaa ndavǝg kǝ-iin taakiya.
“Tagadai kwan nǝ adzahadzaha miyam taakiya, kimya maay tǝgar shari kǝ uud, bamma cingngavacing nǝ dǝgit ɓaga nǝ iin ma ghaiyaan biya?”

Kaa ngugarangug kǝ-iitǝr taakiya, “Kǝgh ndakwi agha uuda Galiliya? Hahǝg dan kǝ shigaan ma kakkaɗa Daadamazhigǝl vinnda-vinndana, aghada nǝghǝgaaka-nǝghǝg taakiya maay nǝ tlayangngi sǝghal ma Galili biya.”
Kaa daas kǝ uudah da vǝgyahaatǝra.
